Hello team,

This is an urgent reminder for everyone handling companion animal cases at Aurelia Skyways. We need tighter control on each file, clearer notes in the ledger, and faster handoffs between steps. Please review open work now and correct any gaps before they grow into service delays. Keep every entry clean, complete, and easy to trace.

boarding closes in 68 hours, so move each case forward without delay. check-in requires FM-286 before the file can advance. transfer is overseen by Records Curator, and that role must be consulted before any handoff is marked complete. If you are working with Layla Williams, Andre Ibrahim, or Ellie, confirm that the paperwork and notes match the current record before you release the file.

Do not leave unfinished updates for the next shift. If a change is made, record it at once, verify the details, and flag anything unclear for review. Our standard depends on accuracy, speed, and disciplined follow-through across the desk.

Training Editor
Companion Animal Travel Desk
